snippet.title: SWAPMEAT | Roguelite Co-Op Meat 'em Up Coming 2025
snippet.description:
Welcome to SWAPMEAT: a frenetic roguelite meat 'em up coming later this year. Rip through alien worlds solo or co-op, harvest mutant body parts to wield their powers, and fulfill your delicious destiny.

Enter Meat Lab 5, our next playtest, May 15-22 and get a taste of what we're working on!

WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790700/SWAPMEAT/
PLAYTEST: https://playswapmeat.com
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/swapmeat
